Item.name: (MKT) Enter/reverse at market
Item.help:
Opens order at current market price
If there already is existing order to an opposite direction, it closes it first.

Param.name: Magic Number
Param.help: Magic number is used to identify this trade, it should be unique for every trade you open.

Param.name: Allow Duplicate Trades
Param.help: If set to true, it will allow to place multiple trades with the same Magic Number

Param.name: Exit After Bars
Param.help: Number of bars after which this trade will automatically be closed

Item.name: Market Position Is Long
Item.help: Is triggered if the first identified live order that fits the criteria is Long. It doesn't consider pending orders.

Param.name: Magic Number
Param.help: Magic number that can identify the order.

Param.name: Comment
Param.help: Comment can be also used to identify the order. In case of Comment, order matches if the order comments contains the text specified here.
